subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2: Climate Change – Introducing Climate Change
outcomes: Recognise climate words like drought, floods, heat waves and ice caps.
Explain the difference between weather and climate.
Talk about the effects of climate change and how it makes me feel.

tf.s: A drought is a long period without rain.
tf.why: Yes! The land becomes very dry.

tf.s: Floods happen when water covers the land or streets, often after heavy rain.
tf.why: Correct, floods are too much water.

tf.s: Weather and climate mean exactly the same thing.
tf.why: Weather is today's conditions; climate is the pattern over a long time.

tf.s: Climate is the weather in one place over a long period of time.
tf.why: Right, that is the definition from the interview.

tf.s: Climate change means average global temperatures are falling.
tf.why: Climate change means average temperatures are rising.

tf.s: A heat wave is a period of very high temperatures.
Higher temperatures can cause the ice caps to melt.
tf.why: Yes, global warming melts the ice.

tf.s: 'It is raining today' describes the climate of a place.
tf.why: That is the weather, because it is only about today.

tf.s: If we do not take action, there will be no consequences for animals and plants.
tf.why: There may be serious consequences for people, animals and plants.

tf.s: A drought happens because there is too much rain.
tf.why: Too much rain causes floods; a drought means no rain for a long time.

boxes.q: Water covers the streets after heavy rain. This is ...
boxes.why: Floods are caused by too much water.

boxes.q: A long period without rain is a ...
boxes.why: In a drought the land is very dry.

boxes.q: Very high temperatures for many days is a ...
boxes.why: A heat wave is a period of extreme heat.
Global warming melts the ice caps.

boxes.q: Climate is the weather in one place ...
Climate change means average global temperatures are ...
Which sentence is about the weather?
o: Summers in Oman are always long.

boxes.q: Which word means 'something that may cause danger'?
boxes.why: Climate change is a threat to many animals.

boxes.q: What is one effect of climate change?
boxes.why: Rising temperatures bring more heat waves.
Oman is generally very hot and dry.

hunt.q: Too much water on the land
Many days of very high heat
Large areas of ice at the poles
Weather pattern over a long time

o: the weather in one place over a long period of time
mcq.why: Climate is the long-term pattern of weather.

o: a lot of rain in one day

mcq.why: The planet is getting warmer over time.

mcq.q: Which of these is an effect of climate change?

o: Climate change is a threat to many animals.
mcq.why: A threat is something that may cause harm.

mcq.q: A picture shows dry, cracked ground and dead plants. What does it show?
mcq.why: Dry, cracked land is a sign of drought.

mcq.q: Which sentence describes Oman's climate, not today's weather?
o: Summers in Oman are hot and dry.
It rained in Muscat this morning.
mcq.why: Climate is about the usual pattern over a long time.

mcq.q: What probably caused the ice caps to melt?
mcq.why: Global warming makes the ice melt.

mcq.q: Why are melting ice caps dangerous?
o: The sea level rises and can cause floods.
mcq.why: More water in the sea raises its level.

mcq.q: Why might the pictures of floods and drought make people feel worried?
o: They show serious damage to people and nature.
mcq.why: These pictures show how climate change harms our world.
